theme_and_colors.emotional_tone: Luxurious, tactile, and deeply focused. Vampire Tech meets high-end productivity.
theme_and_colors.background_strategy: A deep charcoal-red base layered with a textured paper image background to create a physical 'shadowed wallpaper' feel. The neumorphic UI elements will sit on top of this, looking like extruded or carved clay.

neumorphism_specification.concept: Soft-UI tactile surfaces providing embossed (raised) and debossed (pressed) states.
implementation_rules: Define standard CSS variables in index.css for the box-shadows. Use classes like `.neu-raised` and `.neu-pressed`.
The background color of a neumorphic element MUST exactly match its parent's background color. Do not use gradients or different shades for the element surface.
Apply `.neu-pressed` to: active menu items, text inputs, pressed buttons, and the main chat container.
Apply `.neu-raised` to: sidebar container, cards, default buttons, and modal dialogs.
Buttons should transition smoothly: default `.neu-raised`, on `:active` switch to `.neu-pressed`.

rules: Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) in dark mode, use the defined off-white text variable to prevent halation.
Use bold/black weights (font-bold, font-black) for headers to contrast with the soft UI elements.
Tracking: Tight tracking (-0.02em) on large headings, loose tracking on uppercase labels.

layouts_and_grids.ui_scaling_strategy: Implement a `--ui-scale: 1;` CSS variable on the `:root` and `.dark` selectors. Apply it to the HTML font-size: `html { font-size: calc(16px * var(--ui-scale)); }`. Bind the UI Settings slider to update this CSS variable dynamically.
layouts_and_grids.app_structure: 100vh layout. The left sidebar is a collapsible container (from 280px to 80px to 0px). Main content area takes the remaining flex space.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grids: Use tight bento grids (gap-4 or gap-6) for the Admin/User Dashboards. Make sure the widgets utilize the `.neu-raised` class.

component_guidelines.sidebar: Extruded surface (.neu-raised) from the base. Needs a smooth width transition for the collapsible toggle.
component_guidelines.chat_panel: The chat messages area should look debossed (.neu-pressed) like a recessed tray, holding the chat bubbles.
component_guidelines.chat_bubbles: Should NOT use heavy shadows. Use flat, subtle background tints to maintain readability inside the recessed tray.
component_guidelines.inputs_and_search: Use inset shadows (.neu-pressed) exclusively. They should look physically hollowed out.
component_guidelines.assets_thumbnails: Upload/download cards in the assets folder should be raised, with a subtle hover effect that scales up 2%.
component_guidelines.theme_toggle: A tactile physical toggle switch that visually sinks in on one side when flipped.

motion_and_interactions.micro_animations: All hover and active states MUST be animated. Box-shadow transitions should be ~0.2s ease.
motion_and_interactions.sidebar_collapse: Use Framer Motion or pure CSS transitions (width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)).
motion_and_interactions.loading_states: Use subtle skeleton pulsing or an abstract geometric spinner that fits the neumorphic theme.

accessibility.contrast: Since neumorphism relies on low-contrast shadows, text and icons MUST have high contrast against the surface color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, sidebar toggles, settings sliders) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="sidebar-toggle-button"`).
accessibility.focus_states: Do not rely purely on box-shadow for focus. Add a visible 2px outline or distinct color shift on `:focus-visible`.

textures.description: Dark red textured paper wall. Use this for the background wallpaper effect, blended with the base color (e.g. mix-blend-mode: overlay, opacity: 0.1).

placeholders.description: Abstract 3D shape, good for default project or workspace icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement light/dark mode using Tailwind's `dark:` classes and a wrapper component that toggles a `.dark` class on the `<html>` or `<body>` element.
Create a comprehensive custom CSS file (index.css) to hold the `.neu-raised` and `.neu-pressed` utility classes, utilizing CSS variables for the shadow colors to allow seamless theme switching.

Implement the UI scaling slider in the Settings Page. Ensure it updates a `--ui-scale` CSS variable on the document root, and ensure tailwind uses rems (which it does by default) so the entire layout scales proportionally.
Ensure the login screen is easy to use, featuring clear debossed inputs and raised primary buttons.
For the integrations wizard (N8N, LLMs), utilize a bento-box grid layout with raised cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment and dynamic asymmetrical grids when applicable.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions for specific properties only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui and adapt them to the Neumorphic style by stripping borders and replacing them with shadow utilities.
The codebase uses .js files, so avoid TypeScript syntax.
